objective.name: input.answer
objective.description: Answers an open request for input: validates the answer against the kind of the request, records it, and lets the waiting capacity go on.

#root.role: Record the answer of a person to an open request of a continuity, so that the input.request that waits for it answers.

effects.continuity: Appends an input_response line to the journal of the continuity.
effects.external: Wakes at once the input.request that waits for this request in the same process.

transformation_contract.morphing: An answer of a person becomes the response of an open request.
invariants: The answer is validated against the kind of the request: text must be non-empty, choice must be exactly one of the choices, confirm must be yes or no; an invalid answer is refused and the request stays open.
The first valid answer closes the request: one input_response line carrying the answer is written, and the input.request that waits for it goes on.
The same answer again gives the same result and writes nothing more; another answer to an already answered request is refused (reason already_answered).
A closed request cannot be answered (refused, reason closed).
input.answer writes only the input_response line.
success: The request is answered and the waiting capacity can answer its own intention.
failure: Fails with an invalid request when continuity_id, request_id or answer is missing, or when the answer does not suit the kind of the request.
Fails not found when the continuity has no such request.
notes: Two answers at the same time: the one written first counts, the other is compared with it.

#validate.role: Validate the answer against the kind of the request.

transformation_contract.morphing: A raw answer becomes an answer of the kind asked, or a refusal.
A valid answer becomes the response of the request.
